review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: The Nuclear Company is the fastest growing AI tech-enabled startup in the nuclear and energy space, pioneering a fleet-scale approach to building the next generation of nuclear reactors. Through our design-once, build-many model, we're accelerating the deployment of safe, reliable, and affordable nuclear energy. We operate with an AI-first mindset. Every employee is expected to leverage AI, technology, and the Nuclear Operating System (NOS) as integral components of their role to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. We expect every team member to continuously identify opportunities to automate workflows, enhance decision-making, improve processes, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of NOS as a strategic operating capability that enables The Nuclear Company to scale with excellence. We hire people who are driven by purpose, thrive in ambiguity, and are energized by building what has never been built before. Our team combines intellectual curiosity with high agency, embraces candid feedback and continuous learning, and holds themselves and others to exceptional standards. Our values— Transparency, Responsibility, Unity, Scrappy, and Tenacity —guide how we hire, collaborate, and make decisions every day. They are not words on a wall; they are the standard by which we operate. TRUST is the foundation of our safety culture, fostering intellectual honesty, accountability, and open communication, while our values challenge every team member to execute with urgency, humility, resilience, and an unwavering commitment to our mission. About The Role The Nuclear Company is seeking a Senior Systems Administrator to securely administer and scale Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, managed endpoints, AWS, and Windows/Linux server environments. This role serves as the primary administrator and Tier 3 escalation point for assigned platforms, remediates legacy configuration risks, and builds automation that makes provisioning, compliance evidence, and reporting repeatable. The Senior Systems Administrator partners with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, HR, Legal, and Engineering to maintain reliable, auditable services and support the organization's compliance and audit-readiness objectives. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical professional with a security-first mindset who moves effectively in a fast-paced environment and automates high-value, repeatable work. Responsibilities Microsoft 365 and Identity Administration Administer and securely scale Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, mail flow, retention, sharing, and licensing. Administer Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, role-based access control, privileged access, and user lifecycle processes. Audit user and administrator accounts, security groups, roles, and licenses; remediate orphaned identities, excessive access, and legacy configuration issues. Configure and operate assigned DLP and insider-risk technical controls in partnership with Cybersecurity and Legal and in accordance with approved policies and applicable requirements. Endpoint and Device Lifecycle Management Standardize enrollment and compliance through Intune across Windows, macOS, and iOS, and use NinjaOne or another approved RMM platform for supported endpoint monitoring and management. Maintain device naming, security baselines, configuration policies, patching, software deployment, inventory accuracy, and remediation workflows. Support the complete device lifecycle, including onboarding, refresh, reassignment, and secure offboarding. Cloud and Server Administration Administer and maintain Microsoft Azure and AWS environments, with Azure serving as a primary enterprise platform. Establish scalable standards across both platforms for identity and access management, security configuration, logging, monitoring, backup, and recovery to support current operations and future growth. Administer Windows Server and Linux environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, system hardening, patching, and operational monitoring. Maintain system backup and recovery procedures, perform documented restoration tests, and support execution of disaster recovery plans owned by the Manager, Infrastructure & Operations. Automation and Process Improvement Build PowerShell automation, supplemented by Bash or Python where appropriate, for provisioning, compliance validation, reporting, and routine administration. Develop repeatable, scalable processes for system deployment, configuration management, and lifecycle administration. Use approved AI-assisted tools responsibly to improve scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational reliability. Maintain current procedures, system documentation, runbooks, and evidence needed for operational continuity and audits. Tier 3 Escalation and Cross-Functional Support Serve as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex Microsoft 365, identity, endpoint, AWS, and server issues within the role's assigned scope. Lead multi-system troubleshooting and coordinate handoffs to Infrastructure, Network, Cybersecurity, application owners, or vendors when issues cross ownership boundaries. Partner with HR, Legal, Engineering, and other business functions on onboarding, offboarding, access, automation, and audit-readiness initiatives. Provide technical guidance and reusable troubleshooting documentation to IT Support Specialists. Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, plus at least 5 years of progressive systems administration experience. Strong Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID administration experience, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Conditional Access, security groups, RBAC, licensing, and identity lifecycle management. Hands-on endpoint and server administration experience using Intune across Windows, macOS, and iOS; Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy; and familiarity with RMM concepts. Advanced PowerShell automation skills, a solid command of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VLANs), and a disciplined troubleshooting approach for complex, multi-system issues; ability to use approved AI-assisted tools responsibly in technical workflows. Preferred Experience Experience with zero-trust architecture, privileged identity management, or Microsoft Purview information-protection capabilities. Experience in a regulated or high-assurance environment such as nuclear, energy, defense, or the federal sector. Familiarity with frameworks and requirements such as NIST SP 800-53, CMMC, NRC cybersecurity guidance, or 10 CFR 73.54. Familiarity with automation or configuration-management tools beyond PowerShell, such as Bash, Python, Terraform, or Ansible Experience with NinjaOne or a comparable RMM platform; knowledge of ITIL or similar service-management practices; and experience with observability or AIOps platforms. Benefits Competitive compensation packages 401k with company match Medical, dental, vision plans Generous vacation policy, plus holidays Estimated Starting Salary Range The estimated starting salary range for this role is $121,000 - $143,000 annually less applicable withholdings and deductions, paid on a bi-weekly basis. The actual salary offered may vary based on relevant factors as determined in the Company’s discretion, which may include experience, qualifications, tenure, skill set, availability of qualified candidates, geographic location, certifications held, and other criteria deemed pertinent to the particular role. EEO Statement The Nuclear Company is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an environment of inclusion in the workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We prohibit discrimination in all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, demotion, transfer, compensation, and termination. Export Control Certain positions at The Nuclear Company may involve access to information and technology subject to export controls under U.S. law. Compliance with these export controls may result in The Nuclear Company limiting its consideration of certain applicants. Recruiting Fraud Alert Your safety is our priority. We want to ensure your job search stays secure. Please note that the team at The Nuclear Company only communicates through official @thenuclearcompany.com email addresses. We will never ask for payments or sensitive financial information at any stage of our recruitment process. For your peace of mind, please verify all openings and submit your applications directly through our official careers page .

review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: Infrastructure Engineer BSS Location: Hybrid; with regular travel expected to client site or Logiq’s offices in Bristol, Chippenham or Exeter. Salary: Negotiable, plus up to 10% performance bonus*, plus excellent benefits package. Logiq is a fast-growing Technology Company, providing cutting-edge solutions to high-risk clients across Private and Public Sector. Due to rapid growth in our Architecture Capability, we are looking for experienced Solution or Technical Architecture Consultants to join our team. Bespoke Secure Solutions (BSS) is part of the Architecture Practice which brings together highly experienced technologists and IT professionals with a passion for delivering complex solutions that drive tangible uplifts in capability for clients and their users. We specialise in Enterprise and Solution Architecture, Systems Engineering, Service Management and DevOps, to build highly effective teams tailored to the problem-space and requirements. As part of the BSS Team , you’ll have the opportunity to: Develop solutions for complex and unique operating environments Adapt leading edge technology solutions for novel and challenging use cases Build effective multi-discipline teams capable of delivering to the highest assurance levels We thrive on the collaborative success of highly skilled engineering teams that deliver impactful change, supporting our clients to make a difference and achieve their mission. Why Join Us? Work on impactful projects that unlock value from the latest technology and innovation. Join a practice of enthusiastic IT professionals, always willing to learn, share and collaborate Access professional development pathways tailored to your career ambitions. Enjoy flexible working arrangements and a competitive benefits package. The Role: The IT Infrastructure Engineer is a suitably qualified and experienced person (SQEP) responsible for the detailed design, build, testing, and delivery of system components within the scope of their responsibility. This scope, along with relevant Requirements will be provided by the Lead Solution Architect. Fulfilment criteria, along with testing evidence required, will be agreed with the Lead Solution Architect, Systems Engineer, Service Architect and Lead Security Architect. They will work in close collaboration with the Lead Solution Architect and other delivery and service stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Design & Build Design infrastructure solutions (hardware, software, network, platform) that meet functional and non-functional requirements defined by the Lead Solution Architect. Build and configure infrastructure components in accordance with agreed design standards and security/compliance requirements. Document the solution using a range of methods that include key design decisions, architectural rationale and build & configuration artefacts in order to deliver a Low-Level Design (LLD). Integration with other relevant subsystems and components across the technical solution. Security In collaboration with the Lead Security Architect and Lead Solution Architect, define security control implementation based upon the risk assessment and control recommendations. Service Management In collaboration with the Service Architect, determine, document and undertake the transition for the as-is to the to-be solution within their scope of responsibility and create relevant service artefacts as agreed with the Service Architect and Lead Solution Architect. Testing In collaboration with the Systems Engineer, define and undertake testing to demonstrate fulfilment of requirements including Functional, Service, Security, Performance, reliability and availability requirements. Support User Acceptance Testing as needed. It should be noted that a Low-Level Design (LLD) is considered a detailed 'design and configuration' artefact that enables the build of a solution component and assists other suitably qualified and experienced persons (SQEP) familiar with the relevant technology to understand what the function of a component is, how it has been built and what is its configuration. It should provide suitable context to the SQEP reader on key design decisions made during the design. It can take several forms including: A textual document that details the design intention and configuration in a narrative form; a script or computer code that creates the required solution component. A solution component creation method via other automated means including the use of Computer Aided Design, model-based instantiations or Artificial Intelligence which may result in a non-human readable delivery artefact, or one where specialist skills or tools are needed to interpret the artefact. A pre-configured solution component provided by a third-party with relevant installation instructions including 'appliances'; artefacts reused or repurposed from other appropriate sources. Stakeholder Engagement Collaborate with: Project Management to define deliverables and delivery timescales, assist in planning activities, manage Risk, Assumptions, Issues and Dependencies and Opportunities and support Change activities as required. Lead Solution Architect to identify scope of responsibility, relevant requirements and detailed deliverables and to ensure solution alignment with system-level architecture and programme requirements. Systems Engineer to define testable acceptance criteria for infrastructure components. Service Architect to ensure designed solutions are supportable, align with service management principles (e.g. ITIL) and create service artefacts including knowledgebase articles and operation guides as needed. Lead Security Architect to ensure that the security controls derived from the system risk assessment are agreed, included in the component design and build, well defined and testable. Delivery Support Define and maintain the Bill of Materials (BoM) for infrastructure components within their scope of responsibility, including hardware, software licenses, and support requirements. Create low-level design documentation detailing component configuration, interdependencies, and deployment. Produce operational handover documentation for the service organisation. Skills & Experience Required Proven experience in IT infrastructure engineering (e.g. compute, storage, networking, cloud, virtualisation). Experience of infrastructure delivery projects which are unconnected to corporate systems or the internet. Strong understanding of security controls and system hardening approaches for secure system delivery. Demonstrable ability to deliver infrastructure solutions in complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Strong understanding of system and service management practices and tooling. Experience producing clear, structured, and technically accurate design documentation. Knowledge of testing approaches and test planning from an infrastructure perspective. Desirable Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance standards, notably NIST (SP)800-53, CIS benchmarking and STIGs. Exposure to enterprise architecture and service transition processes. Scope of technical delivery The Project will require expertise across its delivery team in the following technologies: Management of physical hardware incl. Intel Servers, storage systems, network routers, firewalls and switches, backup devices. Networks – traditional (switches, routers, VLANs) and SDN (NSX), 802.1x. Server and Storage Virtualisation (VMware vSphere / VCF & vSAN). Windows Server Build and Role configuration (e.g., AD, file services, Network Policy (RADIUS) server, Application Server) . Windows client Build and Configuration (Windows 11, MECM). Active Directory Domain Services and 2 factor authentication . Windows-based PKI. Endpoint security software including Microsoft Defender and Trellix / McAfee Microsoft SCCM / MECM and WSUS for Windows Image deliver, software delivery and patching. System Monitoring using SCOM. Boldon James File Classifier. Databases – Oracle (for customer apps) , MS SQL Server (for MECM / SCOM). Backup and Recovery using EMC Data Domain, Tape Vaults and Dell Networker / VEEAM backup and restore software. Power Management using UPS and PowerChute software. Transition Design (migrating from the as-is system to the new system). Other information: Logiq is committed to investing in people, offering clear progression pathway into our consultancy service, and we will passionately support professional growth to develop our employees. Flexible working is available including part-time / term time working patterns. All suggestions are welcomed to be discussed as part of a proposed employment package. We are an equal-opportunities employer. *Bonus payments are discretionary and awarded upon successful completion of probation. Benefits Include: Competitive Car Allowance 10% Discretionary Very competitive Pension Scheme Access EV Scheme Access to Private Health Care Flexible Working Hybrid Working Fantastic Company Culture 10 days additional paid leave for reservists and CFAV

review_candidates.title: NETWORK ADMINISTRATOR
review_candidates.description: Overview Quantum Research International, Inc. (Quantum) provides our national defense and federal civilian and industry customers with services and products in the following main areas: 1) Cybersecurity and Information Operations; 2) Space Operations and Control; 3) Aviation Systems; 4) Ground, Air and Missile Defense, and Fires Support Systems; 5) Intelligence Programs Support; 6) Experimentation and Test; 7) Program Management; and (8) Audio/Visual Technology Applications. Quantum's Corporate Office is located in Huntsville, AL, but Quantum actively hires for positions nationwide and internationally. We pride ourselves on providing high quality support to the U.S. Government and our Nation's Warfighters. In addition to our corporate office, we have physical locations in Colorado Springs, CO; Crestview, FL; Orlando , FL and Tupelo, MS. Mission Quantum is seeking an experienced Network Administrator to join our team in a Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) environment. This role involves managing and maintaining virtual and physical IT infrastructure while ensuring compliance with stringent DoD cybersecurity policies and standards. Responsibilities Manage, configure, and maintain network infrastructure in compliance with DoD cybersecurity requirements and SCIF operating standards. Configure, administer, and troubleshoot routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and other network infrastructure devices. Monitor network availability, performance, capacity, and security to ensure reliable and continuous operations. Collaborate with the Cybersecurity Team to implement DISA STIG requirements, remediate vulnerabilities, and maintain network security compliance. Configure and maintain network services and protocols including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, NAT, and access control lists (ACLs). Diagnose and resolve network connectivity, latency, routing, switching, and performance issues across classified and unclassified environments. Administer network authentication and access controls, including Active Directory integration, RADIUS, 802.1X, PKI, and role-based access. Configure and maintain firewalls, security policies, network segmentation, and boundary protection controls in accordance with DoD security requirements. Support network vulnerability assessments, ACAS scans, patching, configuration management, and remediation activities. Maintain network device configurations, firmware, software updates, backups, and recovery procedures. Support implementation and maintenance of secure remote-access and site-to-site VPN solutions. Perform network traffic and packet analysis using tools such as Wireshark to identify and troubleshoot network and application communication issues. Support network infrastructure modernization, lifecycle replacement, and implementation of new network technologies. Develop and maintain network diagrams, configuration baselines, standard operating procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, and other technical documentation. Support RMF, ATO, inspection, audit, and continuous-monitoring activities by providing required network configuration and security evidence. Coordinate with system administrators, cybersecurity personnel, DevSecOps engineers, and external network providers to resolve infrastructure and connectivity issues. Respond to network outages and incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions to minimize operational impact. Required Skills And Qualifications Must possess active DoD Secret clearance with the ability to upgrade to TS/SCI Must have experience in installing, testing, and supporting information systems and/or networks. Must possess specific experience in administration and/or support of computer operating systems and/or network operating systems. Must be able to communicate effectively verbally and in writing. Must have and maintain an appropriate DoDI 8570.01-M (Information Assurance Workforce Improvement Program) certification for the appointed duty level Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking (subnetting, routing, switching, DNS/DHCP, common protocols). Hands-on experience managing multiple Palo Alto firewalls — security rules, policies, and zones. Experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco Catalyst 3850/9300 switches. Experience with Cisco 4311 (ISR) routers. Ability to apply STIGs to network devices and maintain compliance baselines. Hyper-V networking: virtual switches, VLAN tagging, and virtual network adapters. Experience upgrading Palo/Cisco devices Work with other teams to assist and troubleshoot network related issues. Familiarity with networking packet capture tools Familiarity with standard TCP/UDP ports Creating and maintaining network diagrams and documentation. Desired Skills And Qualifications Understanding of - Analytics and providing findings in presentation. AWS networking: VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, NACLs, Transit Gateway, and VPN. Terraform / Infrastructure as Code Familiarity with DoD/government compliance processes (audits, hardening, remediation, CTOs). Experience with DNS manager. Familiarity with SolarWinds SEM/Kiwi Syslog Experience working with a CSD Equal Opportunity Employer/Affirmative Action Employer M/F/D/V: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

review_candidates.title: Senior Network and Cybersecurity Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description Summary This is a senior technical engineering leadership role, operating as the bridge between technical execution and project management. As a primary authority for HVDC Control and Protection, you will contribute to the technical strategy for Network and Cybersecurity, drive excellence in secure architectural design and mentor the engineering team. Working across large scale global projects involving multiple stakeholders, you will lead the full lifecycle, from requirements and design to implementation and development of digital control and Substation Automation Systems. You will serve as the go to expert, ensuring that both internal projects and external stakeholder delivery meet the highest standards of innovation, security, reliability and quality. Job Description Candidates who possess most of the experience outlined below and demonstrate strong motivation to develop expertise in the remaining areas are strongly encouraged to apply. We recognize the multifaceted nature of this role and value both proven experience and a genuine commitment to professional growth. Leadership and Impact Technical Authority and Governance: Serve as the Technical Authority for Network and Cybersecurity domains. You will steer technical direction, approve design choices, and ensure alignment across global, large-scale projects. Influential Leadership: Drive engineering excellence. You will act as a mentor, fostering a culture of technical rigor and innovation, and act as a coach for junior and mid-level engineers. Strategic Stakeholder Management: Translate complex technical strategies into clear business impacts for senior leadership and customers. You will advocate for the team’s technical strategy and facilitate open dialogue between cross functional teams and external suppliers. Innovation Champion: Proactively identify project risks and technical debt, driving timely resolution and implementing continuous improvements in engineering processes, Network and Cybersecurity standards, quality, and best practices. Decision Making: Operate with autonomy. You are empowered to make high-stakes technical decisions and pull in specialized experts when necessary to ensure successful delivery. Key Responsibilities Design and Architecture: Lead the end-to-end design of secure networks and communication architectures, adhering to IEC 62443 3 3 principles. Build functional infrastructure from the ground up (Networking, virtualization, server OS). Compliance and Lifecycle: Ensure adherence to Secure Deployment Guides and Security Assurance Plans. Manage vulnerability monitoring, patch management and disaster recovery processes. Technical Oversight: Define IP address strategies, perform substation level hardening, and evaluate Network and Cybersecurity solutions from 3rd party suppliers. Tendering and Regulatory Support: Support bidding processes with knowledge of regulations such as EU NIS, NERC, and BDES; map requirements between varying Network and Cybersecurity standards. Operational Execution: Lead design, configuration, and testing to meet project budgets and schedules. Oversee FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing) and assist with on-site installation and commissioning of LAN networks. Documentation: Ensure all technical documentation aligns with engineering policies and procedures, including appropriate confidentiality levels. Qualifications And Experience Technical Foundation: Proven expertise in Industrial Networking, Systems Architecture, or Cybersecurity. You should possess relevant technical knowledge gained through either a degree in a related field OR equivalent industry recognized certifications (e.g., GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443 Expert, CCNP, CCIE, VCP). Domain Expertise: Experience in industrial control and protection system design, specifically within Distributed Control Systems and Substation Automation (IEC 61850 environments). Cybersecurity Standards: Applied expertise in IEC 62443 standards (parts 4 1, 4 2, 3 3, 2 4) and hands on experience with firewalls (Fortinet), IDS (Nozomi, Radiflow), VPN/PKI, and endpoint security. Networking: Excellent knowledge of Layer 2 and 3 protocols (IPv4, OSPF, VRRP, LACP, SNMP, SSH, SFTP). Ability to build functional infrastructure from the ground up. Systems and Infrastructure: Experience with virtualization (VMware, HyperV, Proxmox) and Windows Server configuration. Industrial Protocols: Proficient in IEC 101/104, PTP, OPC UA, DNP3, Modbus TCP/IP and diagnostic debugging using Wireshark. Product Familiarity: Experience with GE Reason, Westermo, or Meinberg products is advantageous. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

review_candidates.description: Standard Job Description Lockheed Martin Aeronautics. Be More Than You Can Imagine. At Lockheed Martin Aeronautics, we're taking innovation to the next level. From designing the most advanced air vehicle to designing aircraft that defies gravity, our engineers live on the cutting edge of technology. Never have the opportunities for a technical career been so limitless. Why Lockheed Martin Benefits At Lockheed Martin Aeronautics we value your unique skills and expertise and we aim to give back continuously by offering a wide variety of benefits and amenities to help our employees live flexible, healthy, and fulfilling lives at and outside of work. Some of our team’s favorite perks include: The promotion of Work Life Balance A competitive 401k match and bonus Comprehensive Benefits including Medical/Dental/Life Insurance Long term stability The Challenge Crave a challenge that is also rewarding? This is an operational support role to an active fighter unit; you will be responsible for the security and integrity of our systems that keep our jets flying. It takes more than steel, advanced electronics and engine thrust to make the F-35 Lightning II, the world's fifth generation fighter, take flight. It is the Autonomic Logistics Information System (ALIS) that gives F-35 Lightning II operators the ability to plan, to maintain, to plan and sustain its systems over the life of the air vehicle. ALIS provides the IT backbone and capabilities to support current and future Warfighters across the U.S. and allied military services. As critical members of the F35 Operations Team, all ALIS administrators must be able to: Obtain and maintain Special Access Program clearance required for program access This is an operational support role to active fighter units. Administrators must be willing and able to travel for military deployments/detachments for extended periods of time dependent upon operational needs. Capable of working various shift hours to include weekends to support customer mission requirements. Candidates offered a position may be required to complete a pre-employment medical exam that is designed to ensure capability to deploy with our military customer, which may be to austere environments with limited access to medical care. A Day In The Life As an ALIS Administrator with our F-35 ALIS team partnering with our customer, you will wear many hats; system admin duties, data management duties, network admin duties and mission planning admin duties. ALIS Administrators are generally the first point of contact for customer inquiries, field any questions and/or concern and troubleshoot any reported problems. You will be assigned tasks in most ALIS administrative roles to further develop your skills and increase capabilities within the ALIS administrator role. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Interacting daily with users providing assistance on the ALIS product suite Perform COMSEC duties and adhere to requirements; learn CRO duties Support pilots in Mission Planning/Debriefing and identify/resolve system shortfalls Joint Mission Planning System (JMPS) installation and data updates Support, administer, and monitor associated hardware/software and pilot accounts Maintaining smooth, secure operation of multi user computer systems through coordination with peers, Tier2 and engineers Training ALIS Administrators and users on the ALIS system as needed Backups, restores, and disaster recovery of systems/databases/network equipment Reviewing processes/procedures, collect system operational data for analysis Coordinating extranet equipment installations with enterprise and local communications facilities Basic Qualifications Candidates must have a Secret security clearance with investigation within the last 6 years Ability to obtain and retain DoD IAT Level II certification (Security+, CySA+, or CCNA) within 60 days of hire IT experience of any combination in system/database/network administration Experience with at least one of the following: PowerShell; Virtual Machines; SQLPlus; RMAN; Layers 2&3; firewalls; switches/routers Desired Skills Experience Troubleshooting Web Applications JBOSS (WildFly) Application Server Familiarity Account Maintenance with Active Directory/Oracle/CRM Disaster recovery: backups and restores of physical servers, virtual machines, databases, and network equipment Virtual Machine Management Service (Hyper-V / VMware) Maintaining/upgrading system hardware and startup/shutdown of rack components Applying updates, anti-virus/anti-spyware updates, and patch updates Use of Splunk Log Aggregation and Dashboard Red Hat Enterprise Linux System Administrator Installing Oracle Critical Patches, reviewing tables and DBA views for issues, and locating user session data Managing large Oracle and SQLServer databases Familiarity with Lockheed Martin products and processes, to include the JSF ALIS hardware and software Pay Information Full-Time Salary Range: $85300.00 - $158300.00 At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally. Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics. review_candidates.title: Network Security Tech Lead
review_candidates.description: CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER. It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers. The Team: About The Role Network Security Tech Lead is responsible for both leading and delivering enterprise network security operations. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on technical execution to protect Mattel’s global network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments. The position oversees and contributes to the work of Network Security Engineers and Administrators, ensuring robust firewall, email, and web security, as well as Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) management and compliance with enterprise security standards. The Tech Lead will drive delivery of secure, resilient, and scalable network security services while also acting as a subject matter expert (SME) and escalation point for complex troubleshooting, incident response, and architecture initiatives. This role requires deep technical expertise in Palo Alto Networks technologies, cloud security platforms, PKI, and WAF solutions, along with a commitment to operational excellence and continuous improvement. Roles And Responsibilities Provide direct technical leadership and guidance to Network Security Engineers and Network administrators, ensuring delivery of secure and reliable network protection across enterprise and cloud infrastructures. Lead and actively participate in the deployment, operation, and optimization of Palo Alto Networks (PAN) firewalls (hardware and virtual), Prisma Access, GlobalProtect, and related services. Oversee configuration management, performance tuning, and security policy enforcement across global firewall environments. Manage and maintain enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), including certificate lifecycle management with tools such as Keyfactor, Venafi, or equivalent, and integrations with external Certificate Authorities (GlobalSign, Entrust, DigiCert). Lead configuration, customization, and maintenance of Web Application Firewalls (WAF) (e.g., Imperva) to safeguard applications and APIs, resolving rule conflicts and performance issues. Oversee Email Security Gateways (e.g., Checkpoint Harmony, Proofpoint) and related O365 mail routing and DNS security configurations. Participate in high-severity incident response, threat mitigation, and root cause analysis alongside infrastructure and SOC teams. Develop and maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and technical documentation to support security operations, compliance, and audit readiness. Drive continuous improvement in firewall automation, rule optimization, and network visibility using modern tools and analytics. Collaborate with enterprise architects, SOC teams, and application owners to align network security initiatives with business and compliance objectives. Lead or contribute to design discussions, roadmap planning, and implementation of emerging technologies such as Zero Trust network architecture and cloud-native security controls. Mentor engineers, foster professional growth, and promote a culture of accountability and delivery excellence. Participating in after-hours support rotation for major outages or critical incidents as needed. Skills And Qualifications Required: 10+ years of experience in Network Security operations, including at least 5 years in a tech lead role or senior engineering capacity within a large enterprise. Proven expertise with Palo Alto Networks firewalls, Prisma Access, Global Protect, and related security platforms. Experience managing WAF, Email Security, and PKI environments, including integration with cloud services (Azure, AWS, GCP). Proficiency in firewall rules are optimization, troubleshooting, and automation. Deep understanding of network protocols, VPNs, RADIUS/TACACS+, and cloud networking architectures. Familiarity with Windows and Linux systems administration and integration. Experience supporting compliance and audit initiatives (e.g., SOX, NIST CSF, PCI). Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills, with a demonstrated ability to mentor and manage technical teams. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and vendors. Preferred Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Cybersecurity, or related discipline. Certifications such as PCNSE, CCNP Security, CCSP, or GIAC (GSEC). Experience with ServiceNow ITSM processes and workflow automation. Familiarity with Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) and SASE frameworks. Scripting and automation experience (PowerShell, Python, or REST APIs). Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. How We Work We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower. We innovate At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking. We execute We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results. Our Approach to Flexible Work: We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter. Who We Are Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more. Visit us at https //jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers . Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment. Videos to watch The Culture at Mattel Corporate Philanthropy

Whether we're supporting governments, enterprise organisations, or growing businesses, we're committed to creating meaningful outcomes for our customers, communities, and each other. About The Role We’re looking for an experienced Senior Network Engineer to join our team in Adelaide and help deliver reliable, secure, and high-performing network services across complex customer environments. In this role, you’ll be responsible for supporting the day-to-day operation of enterprise networks, leading technical incident resolution, and driving continuous improvements across network infrastructure. Working across a broad range of networking technologies, you’ll collaborate with customers, vendors, carriers, and internal teams to ensure network services remain available, optimised, and aligned to business needs. You’ll also play an important role in mentoring engineers, sharing technical expertise, and contributing to operational excellence. This is a permanent hybrid opportunity based in Adelaide and includes participation in an on-call support roster. You will need Australian citizenship with the ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance to be considered. What You’ll Do Support the operational management of enterprise and managed network environments. Lead the investigation and resolution of network incidents, service requests, alerts, and performance issues. Analyse network performance data and identify opportunities to improve reliability, security, and efficiency. Implement, test, monitor, and optimise network hardware and software to ensure strong system performance. Plan and document network changes, including implementation, testing, risk assessment, and rollback activities. Create and maintain accurate technical documentation and operational records. Monitor service provider performance and work with vendors and carriers to resolve issues and maintain service levels. Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineers and associate engineers. Contribute to operational reporting and recommend improvements to network services and processes. Support customer environments while collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to deliver effective outcomes. What You’ll Bring At least 5-7 years of hands-on experience in networking and network operations. Proven experience configuring and maintaining network, security, communications, and data centre infrastructure. Strong knowledge of networking and firewall technologies across data centres, LAN, and WAN environments. Working knowledge of wireless, mobility, telephony, and cloud networking technologies. Strong understanding of network and security management platforms and associated monitoring and reporting tools. In-depth experience with routing, switching, firewalls, security appliances, DNS, internet connectivity, wireless infrastructure, and WAN technologies. Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead technical investigations and coordinate resolution activities. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A strong customer focus and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively. Essential: At least two of CCNP, CCSE, or equivalent industry certifications. Desirable: CCIE, CCSM, public cloud certifications, Linux/Unix administration experience, project management certification, Python or Perl skills, or a relevant tertiary qualification. Australian citizenship with the ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance. From industry-leading learning and development opportunities to parental leave, wellbeing support, and employee benefits, we're committed to helping our people thrive both professionally and personally We're passionate about creating a workplace where people feel supported, empowered, and inspired to do their best work. Whether you're developing new skills, tackling complex challenges, or collaborating with some of the best minds in the industry, you'll be part of a team that values curiosity, innovation, inclusion, and making a genuine difference. review_candidates.title: Technical Operations Specialist
review_candidates.description: Technical Operations Specialist – Support & Training **THIS IS NOT AN I.T RELATED ROLE** Location: London Head Office, Park Royal or Warmup Luton office / hybrid working by agreement Department: Technical Operations Reports to: Technical Director Salary: £35,000–£45,000 per annum, depending on experience, plus discretionary bonus aligned to the TechOps structure About Warmup and the ProTech team Warmup is a global leader in smart, energy-efficient heating, designing and supplying trusted underfloor heating systems, controls and connected heating solutions for homes, installers, distributors and commercial projects around the world. We have supplied underfloor heating systems to more than 2.5 million homes worldwide and continue to grow through practical innovation, product quality and excellent technical support. You will join ProTech, Warmup’s technical engine room: a collaborative, hands-on team that turns product knowledge into better customer outcomes. ProTech supports global Client Services, Sales, Marketing, Technical Writing and product teams by solving escalated technical issues, improving installer guidance, creating training, and building the knowledge systems that help colleagues and customers get the right answer faster. This is a team for people who enjoy understanding how things work, translating technical detail into clear guidance, and making support smarter, more consistent and more scalable. About the role As Technical Operations Specialist – Support & Training, you will provide specialist 2nd-line technical support, own and improve product training, and create clear, accurate technical content for Warmup’s global teams and installer audiences. You will resolve escalated issues wherever possible, capture root causes and recurring patterns, and turn that learning into stronger guidance, better knowledge-base content and more effective training. What you’ll do Provide 2nd-line technical support for escalations from global Client Services, diagnosing issues using logs, photos, videos, installation details and bench testing where required. Resolve common and complex issues wherever possible, escalating only novel or higher-risk cases with clear handover packs for the Technical Director. Create, deliver and continually improve product training for internal teams and external installers, including session planning, practical exercises, facilitator notes, feedback loops and follow-up improvements. Author and maintain user-facing technical collateral including Operation and Maintenance guides, Quick Start guides, Help Sheets and manual updates. Build and curate internal Q&A content and customer-facing Knowledge Centre material, tagging content for AI-assisted self-service and using support patterns to reduce repeat queries. Create and support digital learning assets such as video tutorials, e-learning modules, storyboards, scripts and interactive guidance in collaboration with Marketing. Perform demonstration installs, validate instructions from an installer’s perspective and contribute to selective practical or field validation work. Publish technical communications such as training updates, SharePoint posts and short blogs on underfloor heating, controls and regulatory themes. What we’re looking for Experience providing technical support, product guidance or troubleshooting in a structured service environment. Strong written communication, with the ability to make technical information clear, accurate and useful for non-specialist audiences. Confidence delivering product or technical training to colleagues, installers or customers. Logical troubleshooting skills and the ability to gather and interpret evidence from photos, videos, logs, wiring details and installation information. Good organisation, attention to detail and confidence maintaining records, schedules and follow-up actions. Experience creating guides, FAQs, help sheets, training decks, knowledge-base entries or similar technical content. Proficiency with Microsoft 365; experience with Adobe Creative Suite, e-learning tools or CAD is desirable. Knowledge of underfloor heating, heating controls, electrical products, construction products or building services is desirable. What we offer Salary of £35,000–£45,000 per annum, depending on experience. Discretionary bonus aligned to the TechOps structure. Employer pension contributions in line with government requirements. Private healthcare after successful completion of probation, subject to scheme rules. Life assurance Income protection 24 days’ annual leave in the first calendar year, pro-rated as applicable. Eyesight checks and a contribution towards glasses. Cycle to work scheme. A supportive, practical team environment with opportunities to build specialist technical expertise and contribute to global learning resources. Application note If you are interested in either role, please send your CV and a short covering note explaining which position you are applying for and why the ProTech support and training work appeals to you. All information received will be kept in strict confidence and used only for employment-related purposes. Whilst the role is advertised as hybrid, the first four weeks will require attendance in the office four days per week.

review_candidates.title: Production Engineer, Network
review_candidates.description: About Fluidstack We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI. We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply! How We Operate Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible. Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. The Production Engineering Team Examples of key problems the team is working on Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket. Link diagnostics across router to router and NIC to router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, because at 10 GW scale debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal. Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself. Automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers, because a new site comes online every six months and manual repair doesn't keep up. Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing. Alerting lifecycle and health dashboards for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10 GW by next year. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it. Role Scope Carry the on-call pager for the network fleet and run repair end to end: diagnose the fault, execute the fix or drive the RMA, and return the link to service across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers. Write Python and Go tooling that replaces manual diagnosis, including link tests, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, so faults resolve in minutes, not hours. Automate the repair pipeline from fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver and optics tracking, and return to service, so a failure at any site follows the same path without manual handoffs. Maintain the realtime monitoring and alerting that gives every on-call engineer a true picture of network health across all sites, and keep it accurate as new sites and hardware roll in. Validate new sites and hardware into production by running the qualification tests that confirm a network is healthy before it carries traffic. What We're Looking For The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would . You've carried a pager for a production network and can walk into an outage, find the fault, fix it or drive the RMA, and write the postmortem without someone walking you through it. You've written Python or Go scripts that replaced a manual, repetitive network task, from link diagnostics to config pushes to fleet-wide command execution. You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each show up differently in the data, and you can tell them apart from the signals alone. You've worked hands-on with link diagnostics, optics, and network monitoring protocols such as gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, and SONiC, and you're comfortable at the CLI on switches and routers across a fleet. You treat toil as a bug. If a repair step means SSHing into ten boxes by hand, you script it once and never do it by hand again. You reach real competence in an unfamiliar part of the stack fast, and you document what you learn so the next on-call engineer doesn't start from zero. Bonus: RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine-leaf). Out-of-band network management. Fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to move faster on scripts and tooling. We are committed to pay equity and transparency. Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law. You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application-- someone from our recruiting team will be in touch. Compensation Range: $173K - $279K

Every employee is expected to leverage AI, technology, and the Nuclear Operating System (NOS) as integral components of their role to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. We expect every team member to continuously identify opportunities to automate workflows, enhance decision-making, improve processes, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of NOS as a strategic operating capability that enables The Nuclear Company to scale with excellence. We hire people who are driven by purpose, thrive in ambiguity, and are energized by building what has never been built before. Our team combines intellectual curiosity with high agency, embraces candid feedback and continuous learning, and holds themselves and others to exceptional standards. Our values— Transparency, Responsibility, Unity, Scrappy, and Tenacity —guide how we hire, collaborate, and make decisions every day. They are not words on a wall; they are the standard by which we operate. TRUST is the foundation of our safety culture, fostering intellectual honesty, accountability, and open communication, while our values challenge every team member to execute with urgency, humility, resilience, and an unwavering commitment to our mission. About The Role The Nuclear Company is seeking a Senior Systems Administrator to securely administer and scale Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, managed endpoints, AWS, and Windows/Linux server environments. This role serves as the primary administrator and Tier 3 escalation point for assigned platforms, remediates legacy configuration risks, and builds automation that makes provisioning, compliance evidence, and reporting repeatable. The Senior Systems Administrator partners with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, HR, Legal, and Engineering to maintain reliable, auditable services and support the organization's compliance and audit-readiness objectives. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical professional with a security-first mindset who moves effectively in a fast-paced environment and automates high-value, repeatable work. Responsibilities Microsoft 365 and Identity Administration Administer and securely scale Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, mail flow, retention, sharing, and licensing. Administer Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, role-based access control, privileged access, and user lifecycle processes. Audit user and administrator accounts, security groups, roles, and licenses; remediate orphaned identities, excessive access, and legacy configuration issues. Configure and operate assigned DLP and insider-risk technical controls in partnership with Cybersecurity and Legal and in accordance with approved policies and applicable requirements. Endpoint and Device Lifecycle Management Standardize enrollment and compliance through Intune across Windows, macOS, and iOS, and use NinjaOne or another approved RMM platform for supported endpoint monitoring and management. Maintain device naming, security baselines, configuration policies, patching, software deployment, inventory accuracy, and remediation workflows. Support the complete device lifecycle, including onboarding, refresh, reassignment, and secure offboarding. Cloud and Server Administration Administer and maintain Microsoft Azure and AWS environments, with Azure serving as a primary enterprise platform. Establish scalable standards across both platforms for identity and access management, security configuration, logging, monitoring, backup, and recovery to support current operations and future growth. Administer Windows Server and Linux environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, system hardening, patching, and operational monitoring. Maintain system backup and recovery procedures, perform documented restoration tests, and support execution of disaster recovery plans owned by the Manager, Infrastructure & Operations. Automation and Process Improvement Build PowerShell automation, supplemented by Bash or Python where appropriate, for provisioning, compliance validation, reporting, and routine administration. Develop repeatable, scalable processes for system deployment, configuration management, and lifecycle administration. Use approved AI-assisted tools responsibly to improve scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational reliability. Maintain current procedures, system documentation, runbooks, and evidence needed for operational continuity and audits. Tier 3 Escalation and Cross-Functional Support Serve as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex Microsoft 365, identity, endpoint, AWS, and server issues within the role's assigned scope. Lead multi-system troubleshooting and coordinate handoffs to Infrastructure, Network, Cybersecurity, application owners, or vendors when issues cross ownership boundaries. Partner with HR, Legal, Engineering, and other business functions on onboarding, offboarding, access, automation, and audit-readiness initiatives. Provide technical guidance and reusable troubleshooting documentation to IT Support Specialists. Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, plus at least 5 years of progressive systems administration experience. Strong Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID administration experience, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Conditional Access, security groups, RBAC, licensing, and identity lifecycle management. Hands-on endpoint and server administration experience using Intune across Windows, macOS, and iOS; Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy; and familiarity with RMM concepts. Advanced PowerShell automation skills, a solid command of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VLANs), and a disciplined troubleshooting approach for complex, multi-system issues; ability to use approved AI-assisted tools responsibly in technical workflows. Preferred Experience Experience with zero-trust architecture, privileged identity management, or Microsoft Purview information-protection capabilities. Experience in a regulated or high-assurance environment such as nuclear, energy, defense, or the federal sector. Familiarity with frameworks and requirements such as NIST SP 800-53, CMMC, NRC cybersecurity guidance, or 10 CFR 73.54. Familiarity with automation or configuration-management tools beyond PowerShell, such as Bash, Python, Terraform, or Ansible Experience with NinjaOne or a comparable RMM platform; knowledge of ITIL or similar service-management practices; and experience with observability or AIOps platforms. Benefits Competitive compensation packages 401k with company match Medical, dental, vision plans Generous vacation policy, plus holidays Estimated Starting Salary Range The estimated starting salary range for this role is $121,000 - $143,000 annually less applicable withholdings and deductions, paid on a bi-weekly basis. new_matches.title: Infrastructure Engineer
new_matches.description: Infrastructure Engineer BSS Location: Hybrid; with regular travel expected to client site or Logiq’s offices in Bristol, Chippenham or Exeter. Salary: Negotiable, plus up to 10% performance bonus*, plus excellent benefits package. Logiq is a fast-growing Technology Company, providing cutting-edge solutions to high-risk clients across Private and Public Sector. Due to rapid growth in our Architecture Capability, we are looking for experienced Solution or Technical Architecture Consultants to join our team. Bespoke Secure Solutions (BSS) is part of the Architecture Practice which brings together highly experienced technologists and IT professionals with a passion for delivering complex solutions that drive tangible uplifts in capability for clients and their users. We specialise in Enterprise and Solution Architecture, Systems Engineering, Service Management and DevOps, to build highly effective teams tailored to the problem-space and requirements. As part of the BSS Team , you’ll have the opportunity to: Develop solutions for complex and unique operating environments Adapt leading edge technology solutions for novel and challenging use cases Build effective multi-discipline teams capable of delivering to the highest assurance levels We thrive on the collaborative success of highly skilled engineering teams that deliver impactful change, supporting our clients to make a difference and achieve their mission. Why Join Us? Work on impactful projects that unlock value from the latest technology and innovation. Join a practice of enthusiastic IT professionals, always willing to learn, share and collaborate Access professional development pathways tailored to your career ambitions. Enjoy flexible working arrangements and a competitive benefits package. The Role: The IT Infrastructure Engineer is a suitably qualified and experienced person (SQEP) responsible for the detailed design, build, testing, and delivery of system components within the scope of their responsibility. This scope, along with relevant Requirements will be provided by the Lead Solution Architect. Fulfilment criteria, along with testing evidence required, will be agreed with the Lead Solution Architect, Systems Engineer, Service Architect and Lead Security Architect. They will work in close collaboration with the Lead Solution Architect and other delivery and service stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Design & Build Design infrastructure solutions (hardware, software, network, platform) that meet functional and non-functional requirements defined by the Lead Solution Architect. Build and configure infrastructure components in accordance with agreed design standards and security/compliance requirements. Document the solution using a range of methods that include key design decisions, architectural rationale and build & configuration artefacts in order to deliver a Low-Level Design (LLD). Integration with other relevant subsystems and components across the technical solution. Security In collaboration with the Lead Security Architect and Lead Solution Architect, define security control implementation based upon the risk assessment and control recommendations. Service Management In collaboration with the Service Architect, determine, document and undertake the transition for the as-is to the to-be solution within their scope of responsibility and create relevant service artefacts as agreed with the Service Architect and Lead Solution Architect. Testing In collaboration with the Systems Engineer, define and undertake testing to demonstrate fulfilment of requirements including Functional, Service, Security, Performance, reliability and availability requirements. Support User Acceptance Testing as needed. It should be noted that a Low-Level Design (LLD) is considered a detailed 'design and configuration' artefact that enables the build of a solution component and assists other suitably qualified and experienced persons (SQEP) familiar with the relevant technology to understand what the function of a component is, how it has been built and what is its configuration. It should provide suitable context to the SQEP reader on key design decisions made during the design. It can take several forms including: A textual document that details the design intention and configuration in a narrative form; a script or computer code that creates the required solution component. A solution component creation method via other automated means including the use of Computer Aided Design, model-based instantiations or Artificial Intelligence which may result in a non-human readable delivery artefact, or one where specialist skills or tools are needed to interpret the artefact. A pre-configured solution component provided by a third-party with relevant installation instructions including 'appliances'; artefacts reused or repurposed from other appropriate sources. Stakeholder Engagement Collaborate with: Project Management to define deliverables and delivery timescales, assist in planning activities, manage Risk, Assumptions, Issues and Dependencies and Opportunities and support Change activities as required. Lead Solution Architect to identify scope of responsibility, relevant requirements and detailed deliverables and to ensure solution alignment with system-level architecture and programme requirements. Systems Engineer to define testable acceptance criteria for infrastructure components. Service Architect to ensure designed solutions are supportable, align with service management principles (e.g. ITIL) and create service artefacts including knowledgebase articles and operation guides as needed. Lead Security Architect to ensure that the security controls derived from the system risk assessment are agreed, included in the component design and build, well defined and testable. Delivery Support Define and maintain the Bill of Materials (BoM) for infrastructure components within their scope of responsibility, including hardware, software licenses, and support requirements. Create low-level design documentation detailing component configuration, interdependencies, and deployment. Produce operational handover documentation for the service organisation. Skills & Experience Required Proven experience in IT infrastructure engineering (e.g. compute, storage, networking, cloud, virtualisation). Experience of infrastructure delivery projects which are unconnected to corporate systems or the internet. Strong understanding of security controls and system hardening approaches for secure system delivery. Demonstrable ability to deliver infrastructure solutions in complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Strong understanding of system and service management practices and tooling. Experience producing clear, structured, and technically accurate design documentation. Knowledge of testing approaches and test planning from an infrastructure perspective. Desirable Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance standards, notably NIST (SP)800-53, CIS benchmarking and STIGs. Exposure to enterprise architecture and service transition processes. Scope of technical delivery The Project will require expertise across its delivery team in the following technologies: Management of physical hardware incl. Intel Servers, storage systems, network routers, firewalls and switches, backup devices. Networks – traditional (switches, routers, VLANs) and SDN (NSX), 802.1x. Server and Storage Virtualisation (VMware vSphere / VCF & vSAN). Windows Server Build and Role configuration (e.g., AD, file services, Network Policy (RADIUS) server, Application Server) . Windows client Build and Configuration (Windows 11, MECM). Active Directory Domain Services and 2 factor authentication . Windows-based PKI. Endpoint security software including Microsoft Defender and Trellix / McAfee Microsoft SCCM / MECM and WSUS for Windows Image deliver, software delivery and patching. System Monitoring using SCOM. Boldon James File Classifier. Databases – Oracle (for customer apps) , MS SQL Server (for MECM / SCOM). Backup and Recovery using EMC Data Domain, Tape Vaults and Dell Networker / VEEAM backup and restore software. Power Management using UPS and PowerChute software. Transition Design (migrating from the as-is system to the new system). Other information: Logiq is committed to investing in people, offering clear progression pathway into our consultancy service, and we will passionately support professional growth to develop our employees. Flexible working is available including part-time / term time working patterns. All suggestions are welcomed to be discussed as part of a proposed employment package. We are an equal-opportunities employer. *Bonus payments are discretionary and awarded upon successful completion of probation. Benefits Include: Competitive Car Allowance 10% Discretionary Very competitive Pension Scheme Access EV Scheme Access to Private Health Care Flexible Working Hybrid Working Fantastic Company Culture 10 days additional paid leave for reservists and CFAV

(Quantum) provides our national defense and federal civilian and industry customers with services and products in the following main areas: 1) Cybersecurity and Information Operations; 2) Space Operations and Control; 3) Aviation Systems; 4) Ground, Air and Missile Defense, and Fires Support Systems; 5) Intelligence Programs Support; 6) Experimentation and Test; 7) Program Management; and (8) Audio/Visual Technology Applications. Quantum's Corporate Office is located in Huntsville, AL, but Quantum actively hires for positions nationwide and internationally. We pride ourselves on providing high quality support to the U.S. Government and our Nation's Warfighters. In addition to our corporate office, we have physical locations in Colorado Springs, CO; Crestview, FL; Orlando , FL and Tupelo, MS. Mission Quantum is seeking an experienced Network Administrator to join our team in a Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) environment. This role involves managing and maintaining virtual and physical IT infrastructure while ensuring compliance with stringent DoD cybersecurity policies and standards. Responsibilities Manage, configure, and maintain network infrastructure in compliance with DoD cybersecurity requirements and SCIF operating standards. Configure, administer, and troubleshoot routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and other network infrastructure devices. Monitor network availability, performance, capacity, and security to ensure reliable and continuous operations. Collaborate with the Cybersecurity Team to implement DISA STIG requirements, remediate vulnerabilities, and maintain network security compliance. Configure and maintain network services and protocols including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, NAT, and access control lists (ACLs). Diagnose and resolve network connectivity, latency, routing, switching, and performance issues across classified and unclassified environments. Administer network authentication and access controls, including Active Directory integration, RADIUS, 802.1X, PKI, and role-based access. Configure and maintain firewalls, security policies, network segmentation, and boundary protection controls in accordance with DoD security requirements. Support network vulnerability assessments, ACAS scans, patching, configuration management, and remediation activities. Maintain network device configurations, firmware, software updates, backups, and recovery procedures. Support implementation and maintenance of secure remote-access and site-to-site VPN solutions. Perform network traffic and packet analysis using tools such as Wireshark to identify and troubleshoot network and application communication issues. Support network infrastructure modernization, lifecycle replacement, and implementation of new network technologies. Develop and maintain network diagrams, configuration baselines, standard operating procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, and other technical documentation. Support RMF, ATO, inspection, audit, and continuous-monitoring activities by providing required network configuration and security evidence. Coordinate with system administrators, cybersecurity personnel, DevSecOps engineers, and external network providers to resolve infrastructure and connectivity issues. Respond to network outages and incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions to minimize operational impact. Required Skills And Qualifications Must possess active DoD Secret clearance with the ability to upgrade to TS/SCI Must have experience in installing, testing, and supporting information systems and/or networks. Must possess specific experience in administration and/or support of computer operating systems and/or network operating systems. Must be able to communicate effectively verbally and in writing. Must have and maintain an appropriate DoDI 8570.01-M (Information Assurance Workforce Improvement Program) certification for the appointed duty level Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking (subnetting, routing, switching, DNS/DHCP, common protocols). Hands-on experience managing multiple Palo Alto firewalls — security rules, policies, and zones. Experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco Catalyst 3850/9300 switches. Experience with Cisco 4311 (ISR) routers. Ability to apply STIGs to network devices and maintain compliance baselines. Hyper-V networking: virtual switches, VLAN tagging, and virtual network adapters. Experience upgrading Palo/Cisco devices Work with other teams to assist and troubleshoot network related issues. Familiarity with networking packet capture tools Familiarity with standard TCP/UDP ports Creating and maintaining network diagrams and documentation. Desired Skills And Qualifications Understanding of - Analytics and providing findings in presentation. AWS networking: VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, NACLs, Transit Gateway, and VPN. Terraform / Infrastructure as Code Familiarity with DoD/government compliance processes (audits, hardening, remediation, CTOs). Experience with DNS manager. Familiarity with SolarWinds SEM/Kiwi Syslog Experience working with a CSD Equal Opportunity Employer/Affirmative Action Employer M/F/D/V: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
